newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes slightly weaker.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed slightly weaker on Tuesday despite price rises in cement makers and oil refineries, traders said.
"Stocks in the cement and oil refining sector were in demand and some of them closed firmer," one broker said. "But that wasn't enough to push the market up."
Operators said they expected the market to stay almost unchanged throughout the week.
"We expect a bullish phase in September, with investors' return from summer holidays and with reports on first-half results," another trader said.

Two independent market indices slipped due to falls in a large number of small-caps. The BIG-OTC index went down 0.7 percent to 4,421.7, while the CAS-RQ slid 0.2 percent to close at 982 points. The VAB-RA all-share index was not immediately available.
State-run cement maker Romcim closed 2,000 lei higher at 117,000, under buying pressure, but traders said its price might correct slightly on Wednesday in low supply.
Molodocim, another cement maker, finished 400 lei higher at 42,000, while Romcif cement maker inched up by 50 lei to 3,150.
Oil refinery Petromidia ended 1,250 lei up at 43,750, while Petrobrazi refinery firmed 500 lei at 45,500.

Arpechim, another oil refinery, went down 1,500 lei to 38,500. Traders said they expected the Arpechim quote to rise by at least 15-20 percent on Wednesday if speculation that it would be included in a new all-country oil company proved true.

Romania's government on Tuesday is to decide on the composition of the new national oil company, to replace the old one, which included 10 refineries. The government already decided that Petrobrazi would be part of the new company.
